name: Fox & Bear Art Academy
description_short: An art studio in Johnston, RI, that runs a Monday-Friday summer art camp for ages 4-12, with separate Me & My Person sessions for ages 1-3. During the school year it offers after-school art classes in printmaking, drawing and painting.

sources.note: Homepage: Fall 2026-Spring 2027 after-school program; printmaking, drawing and painting.
FAQ: 'Our Summer Camp runs Monday–Friday and is designed for ages 4–12, with dedicated Me & My Person sessions for our youngest artists, ages 1–3.' Address and email.

source.title: Fox and Bear Art Academy  | Explore Art Today — Join Our Classes
